thread_messages.text: Hi Yashdeep! We need a React + FastAPI SaaS dashboard for analytics. Budget is 2.5 MATIC total.

Sounds great. Can we split this into two milestones? Milestone 1: backend auth and data ingestion API for 1.0 MATIC due on Nov 1. Milestone 2: frontend dashboard and charts for 1.5 MATIC due on Nov 20.
Agreed. For Milestone 1, we must have POST /auth/login and /data/upload endpoints with unit tests passing. Repo is https://github.com/client-saas/analytics-mvp on main branch.
Perfect! Standard review window of 5 days and 1% daily late penalty works for me.

post_context: Job: Full-stack Analytics SaaS Dashboard MVP with FastAPI and React
